title: PD Brief
description: Each week, PD Brief explains a newly published Parkinson's study in everyday language for patients, caregivers and anyone else following the research.
author: PD Brief
buttondown_note: Your Buttondown username: the part after buttondown.com/ in your newsletter's address. Once it is filled in and pushed, every issue, the homepage and pdbrief.org/subscribe/ get an email sign-up box.
subscribe_note: Only used if buttondown_username is empty: a link to any other newsletter's signup page.
feedback_note: Paste your Google Form address here to switch on the 'Ask a question' page. Use the full docs.google.com/forms/... /viewform link if you want the form shown inside the page; a forms.gle short link will be shown as a button instead.
google_site_verification_note: Paste the content value from Google Search Console's HTML tag method here, then push. Leave empty if you verify another way.
